title: The Merchant???

options.title: Browse and Purchase
options.description: The merchant has a randomly-selected inventory of 6 relics from their pool. Each relic costs [gold]50 Gold[/gold].

options.title: Throw Foul Potion
options.description: If you have a [gold]Foul Potion[/gold], you can throw it at the merchant, triggering a combat encounter. Defeating the merchant grants you the [gold]Merchant's Rug[/gold] relic plus all remaining unsold relics from their inventory.
options.requires: Requires: Foul Potion in your inventory

conditions: At least 100 Gold OR have a Foul Potion
notes: This is a shop event with a unique twist. The merchant has 6 randomly-selected relics from a fixed pool of 9 available for purchase. If you throw a [gold]Foul Potion[/gold], the merchant becomes hostile and you enter combat. Winning the fight grants the [gold]Merchant's Rug[/gold] relic plus all of the merchant's remaining inventory (including both purchased and unsold relics). The merchant reacts to various player actions with unique dialogue lines.
